en.headline: M+ opens Myths and Monsters exhibition exploring fantasy in Asian visual culture
en.dek: The special exhibition runs from 17 October 2026 to 4 April 2027 at the West Gallery, presenting more than 400 works spanning the nineteenth to twenty-first centuries.
body: M+ Museum in the West Kowloon Cultural District opens the special exhibition Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia on Saturday.
The show runs until 4 April 2027 in the West Gallery and presents more than 400 works across contemporary art, architecture, fashion, video games and film, according to the museum.

Organised in four chapters, it begins with pre-modern traditions such as Japanese ukiyo-e prints, Chinese shadow puppetry and Tibetan Buddhist scrolls, then traces surrealism, the rise of manga and anime, and the global reach of fantastical aesthetics in contemporary culture.

Admission is included in the standard M+ ticket of HK$190 for adults and HK$100 for concession holders, with children aged six and under admitted free. The museum said members and patrons have unlimited access.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展覽周六開幕 探討亞洲視覺文化中的奇幻
zh.dek: 特別展覽由今天至2027年4月4日在西展廳舉行，展出逾400件橫跨十九至二十一世紀的作品。
body: 西九文化區M+博物館周六開幕特別展覽「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」。
展覽至2027年4月4日在西展廳舉行，博物館指展出逾400件當代藝術、建築、時尚、電子遊戲及電影作品。
展覽分為四章，先由日本浮世繪、中國皮影戲及藏傳佛教唐卡等前現代傳統開始，再追蹤超現實主義、漫畫與動畫的興起，以及奇幻美學在當代文化中的全球影響。
門票已包括在M+標準票價內，成人190元，特惠票價100元，六歲或以下小童免費。博物館表示會員及贊助人可無限次入場。
